🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Einkaufen (Shopping)

das Angebot = offer
die Rechnung = bill
die Tasche = bag
der Einkaufswagen = shopping cart
das Obst = fruit
das Gemüse = vegetables

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
